source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: openAddressBookWindow now waits one timer turn inside its onLoad callback before resolving the content window, then still waits for cards-list readiness. The actual new-tab producer already delays onLoad after about-addressbook-ready, while the existing-tab route may call it directly or from a ready event. Keep these callback and list-ready boundaries separate; the new turn is not a general synchronization or CardDAV completion guarantee. Required primary comment 58 remains unavailable, so the finding has zero full-audit credit.
title: The Address Book opener adds a timer turn before its separate card-list readiness wait
